```

```

If "Skip": proceed to step 7 (checker).

### Issues to Fix
{paste blocking issues from checker return}

Read the existing UI-SPEC.md, fix ONLY the listed issues, re-write the file.

## Spawning Indicators

**Liveness convention:** Every spawn announcement must carry the canonical phrase `runs in a subagent` inline so users know that silence during a subagent run is expected. Without this, a healthy 1–5 minute agent looks identical to a frozen session. Single spawns use the singular form; parallel spawns use the plural form.

```
◆ Spawning researcher... (runs in a subagent — no output until it returns, ~1–5 min; expected, not a freeze)

◆ Spawning 4 researchers in parallel... (each runs in a subagent — no output until they return, ~1–5 min; expected, not a freeze)
  → Stack research
  → Features research
  → Architecture research
  → Pitfalls research

✓ Researcher complete: STACK.md written
```

# Phase 68 — UI Design Contract

> Visual and interaction contract for frontend phases. Generated by gsd-ui-researcher, verified by gsd-ui-checker.

## Scope Note

**This phase is primarily backend/client-state (rotation engine wiring, durable IndexedDB high-water state, `folderTree` reconciliation).** The UI surface is intentionally narrow — five notification/status states, all reusing the app's existing notification and header primitives. No new pages, dialogs, or layouts. This contract covers only:

1. A global rotation-progress status badge (app header) — D-02/D-03
2. Four toast-notification variants riding the existing `NotificationToast` component — D-01, D-04, D-05, D-06, D-08

If a reviewer expects more UI surface than this, they are looking at the wrong phase — see Phase 69 (FUSE/desktop) and Phase 63/65 (crypto engine, no UI).

---

## Design System

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Tool | none — hand-rolled CSS custom properties, no component library, no shadcn |
| Preset | not applicable (project does not use shadcn; `components.json` absent by design across the whole monorepo) |
| Component library | none (raw React + plain CSS files per component, e.g. `styles/layout.css`) |
| Icon library | none — terminal aesthetic uses ASCII/text glyphs (`>_`, `[INFO]`, `[WARN]`, `[ERR]`, `[x]`) instead of icon fonts/SVGs |
| Font | `"JetBrains Mono", monospace` (`--font-family-mono`, `apps/web/src/index.css`) |

**Existing design system detected and reused as-is.** `apps/web/src/index.css` defines a complete "terminal/hacker aesthetic" token set (green-on-black, monospace, 1px borders, no border-radius on functional chrome). This phase does not introduce shadcn or any component library — doing so for a five-state notification surface deep in an 88%-complete milestone would be scope creep against an established, working design language. All new UI in this phase must use the existing tokens below, unchanged.

**Reused components (do not rebuild):**

- `apps/web/src/components/NotificationToast.tsx` + `apps/web/src/stores/notification.store.ts` — bottom-right toast stack, extend (do not replace) for D-01/D-04/D-05/D-06/D-08.
- `apps/web/src/components/layout/AppHeader.tsx` + `apps/web/src/styles/layout.css` `.header-right` — mount point for the new rotation status badge (D-02/D-03).

---

## Spacing Scale

Project's existing scale (`apps/web/src/index.css`), reused verbatim — do not introduce a parallel scale:

| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| xs | 8px | Icon/glyph gaps, inline padding (`--spacing-xs`) |
| sm | 12px | Compact element spacing (`--spacing-sm`) |
| md | 16px | Default element spacing (`--spacing-md`) |
| lg | 24px | Section padding (`--spacing-lg`) |
| xl | 32px | Layout gaps (`--spacing-xl`) |

Exceptions: none. Rotation badge padding: `4px 8px` (matches `.header-search-btn`, the closest existing header chrome — not a new value, copied from `apps/web/src/styles/layout.css`).

---

## Typography

Project's existing type scale (`apps/web/src/index.css`), reused verbatim:

| Role | Size | Weight | Line Height |
|------|------|--------|-------------|
| Body / toast message | 11px (`--font-size-sm`) | 400 (`--font-weight-normal`) | 1.5 (global `html` default) |
| Label / badge text | 11px (`--font-size-sm`) | 600 (`--font-weight-semibold`) | 1.5 |
| Status prefix (`[INFO]`/`[WARN]`/`[ERR]`) | 11px (`--font-size-sm`) | 400 | 1.5 |
| Header logo (context only, unchanged) | 14px (`--font-size-md`) | 600 | 1.5 |

Only two weights exist in the whole app (400 normal, 600 semibold) — do not introduce a third. Rotation badge label uses 600/semibold to match `.header-search-btn` styling conventions (bold-ish accent chrome in the header).

---

## Color

Project's existing palette (`apps/web/src/index.css`), reused verbatim:

| Role | Value | Usage |
|------|-------|-------|
| Dominant (60%) | `#000000` (`--color-black` / `--color-background`) | App background |
| Secondary (30%) | `#001108` / `#001a11` (`--color-toolbar-bg` / `--color-nav-active`) | Header/toolbar surfaces, active nav |
| Accent (10%) | `#00D084` (`--color-green-primary`) | Borders, active/focus states, info-toast accent, badge idle/active-safe states |
| Destructive / error | `#EF4444` (`--color-error`) | Error toasts (D-05, D-06, D-01 escalated), never used for anything else |
| Warning | `#F59E0B` (`--color-warning`) | Warning toasts (D-08 one-time notice), rotation-tail badge accent |

Accent (`--color-green-primary`) reserved for: existing focus rings, existing borders on header/search chrome, the rotation badge's idle/in-progress border and glyph color when the walk is healthy (not erroring). Never introduce a new accent color for this phase — reuse the four semantic colors above exactly.

---

## Copywriting Contract

All copy is plain, terse, and matches the existing `[INFO]`/`[WARN]`/`[ERR]` label convention in `NotificationToast.tsx`. No new tone — no exclamation points, no marketing language, consistent with the rest of the app's terminal aesthetic.

### Rotation status badge (D-02/D-03) — mounted in `AppHeader`'s `.header-right`, before `UserMenu`

| State | Trigger | Label | Visual |
|-------|---------|-------|--------|
| Hidden | No rotation active for this session | *(not rendered)* | — |
| Root cut in progress | `rotateReadFromNode` root step running (synchronous) | `Revoking access…` | Spinner + green (`--color-green-primary`) border, non-dismissible |
| Tail walk in progress | Background subtree walk running after root cut completes | `Finishing revocation…` | Static pill, green border, no spinner (avoid implying it's blocking) |
| Resuming after reload | Durable job record found mid-walk on page load | `Resuming revocation…` | Same pill styling as tail-walk state |

Badge is a status pill only — not a button, not focusable, no click action (D-03 explicitly deferred any interactivity; it is informational). `role="status"`, `aria-live="polite"` (never `assertive` — it is not an error).

### Toast notifications (extend `NotificationToast.tsx` / `notification.store.ts`)

| Element | Copy | Type | Notes |
|---------|------|------|-------|
| Reconcile-defer notice (D-04) | `Syncing latest state…` | `info` | Auto-retrying in background; auto-dismisses on success (no manual dismiss needed, but existing `[x]` stays available) |
| Regression rejected (D-05) | `Stale data from server rejected.` | `error` | Per-mutation toast, not a full-page block; the mutation itself did not apply |
| Defer exhausted / terminal (D-06) | `Couldn't complete securely — retry.` | `error` | Requires an action button labeled `Retry` (see Component Extension below); mutation was never applied |
| Offline/stale co-writer write failure (D-01, non-revoked) | `Write failed — access may be out of date.` | `error` | Requires an action button labeled `Refresh access` |
| Offline/stale co-writer, actually revoked (D-01, escalated) | `Write access revoked.` | `error` | No action button — refreshing cannot help; this is terminal |
| IndexedDB unavailable (D-08), shown once per session | `Secure cache unavailable — falling back to server verification.` | `warning` | One-time only; do not re-show on every subsequent mutation this session |

### Component extension required (not a new component)

`Notification` type (`apps/web/src/stores/notification.store.ts`) needs an optional action field to support D-01 (`Refresh access`) and D-06 (`Retry`):

```ts
export type Notification = {
  id: string;
  type: 'info' | 'warning' | 'error';
  message: string;
  createdAt: number;
  action?: { label: string; onClick: () => void };
};
```

`NotificationToast.tsx` renders the action as a small text button matching the existing `[x]` dismiss button's styling (same font, `--color-text-muted` default / `--color-green-primary` on hover, no background, no border-radius) — placed before the `[x]` dismiss button, e.g. `[Retry]` `[x]`. Do not use a filled/primary button style; the whole toast system is text-only chrome.

### Destructive confirmation

Not applicable — this phase adds no destructive actions. (Delete/move/rename confirmations already exist from prior phases and are unchanged here; rotation is a side effect of those existing flows, not a new user-initiated destructive action.)

---

## Registry Safety

| Registry | Blocks Used | Safety Gate |
|----------|-------------|-------------|
| shadcn official | none | not applicable — project does not use shadcn |
| third-party | none | not applicable |

No registries in use. `components.json` intentionally absent project-wide; not introduced by this phase.

Accent (`--color-green-primary`) reserved for: existing focus rings, existing borders on header/search chrome, the rotation badge's idle/in-progress border and glyph color when the walk is healthy (not erroring). Never introduce a new accent color for this phase — reuse the four semantic colors above exactly.

---

## Copywriting Contract

All copy is plain, terse, and matches the existing `[INFO]`/`[WARN]`/`[ERR]` label convention in `NotificationToast.tsx`. No new tone — no exclamation points, no marketing language, consistent with the rest of the app's terminal aesthetic.

### Rotation status badge (D-02/D-03) — mounted in `AppHeader`'s `.header-right`, before `UserMenu`

| State | Trigger | Label | Visual |
|-------|---------|-------|--------|
| Hidden | No rotation active for this session | *(not rendered)* | — |
| Root cut in progress | `rotateReadFromNode` root step running (synchronous) | `Revoking access…` | Spinner + green (`--color-green-primary`) border, non-dismissible |
| Tail walk in progress | Background subtree walk running after root cut completes | `Finishing revocation…` | Static pill, green border, no spinner (avoid implying it's blocking) |
| Resuming after reload | Durable job record found mid-walk on page load | `Resuming revocation…` | Same pill styling as tail-walk state |

Badge is a status pill only — not a button, not focusable, no click action (D-03 explicitly deferred any interactivity; it is informational). `role="status"`, `aria-live="polite"` (never `assertive` — it is not an error).

### Toast notifications (extend `NotificationToast.tsx` / `notification.store.ts`)

| Element | Copy | Type | Notes |
|---------|------|------|-------|
| Reconcile-defer notice (D-04) | `Syncing latest state…` | `info` | Auto-retrying in background; auto-dismisses on success (no manual dismiss needed, but existing `[x]` stays available) |
| Regression rejected (D-05) | `Stale data from server rejected.` | `error` | Per-mutation toast, not a full-page block; the mutation itself did not apply |
| Defer exhausted / terminal (D-06) | `Couldn't complete securely — retry.` | `error` | Requires an action button labeled `Retry` (see Component Extension below); mutation was never applied |
| Offline/stale co-writer write failure (D-01, non-revoked) | `Write failed — access may be out of date.` | `error` | Requires an action button labeled `Refresh access` |
| Offline/stale co-writer, actually revoked (D-01, escalated) | `Write access revoked.` | `error` | No action button — refreshing cannot help; this is terminal |
| IndexedDB unavailable (D-08), shown once per session | `Secure cache unavailable — falling back to server verification.` | `warning` | One-time only; do not re-show on every subsequent mutation this session |

### Component extension required (not a new component)

`Notification` type (`apps/web/src/stores/notification.store.ts`) needs an optional action field to support D-01 (`Refresh access`) and D-06 (`Retry`):

```ts
export type Notification = {
  id: string;
  type: 'info' | 'warning' | 'error';
  message: string;
  createdAt: number;
  action?: { label: string; onClick: () => void };
};
```

`NotificationToast.tsx` renders the action as a small text button matching the existing `[x]` dismiss button's styling (same font, `--color-text-muted` default / `--color-green-primary` on hover, no background, no border-radius) — placed before the `[x]` dismiss button, e.g. `[Retry]` `[x]`. Do not use a filled/primary button style; the whole toast system is text-only chrome.
